text: {"voice": 4, "model_prose": 3, "fidelity": 4, "note": "The semicolon-jointed periods and archaic diction ('concerning the lamb', 'do the office of explanation') echo Johnson well, but the 'Thus' summing-up and the aphoristic 'settles all, and leaves no remainder' close read as model polish, and naming 'Genesis 22' adds a specific the propositions never gave."}
